## Change / 改动

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. / 描述问题以及修改后的行为。

## Validation / 验证

List commands and results. Distinguish Python-only, native headless, Xvfb and
manual desktop evidence. / 列出命令与结果，区分 Python、原生无显示、Xvfb 和桌面人工验收。

## Compatibility / 兼容性

Note any protocol, schema, gameplay or packaging impact. For native changes,
update the dated file notice and game/LOCAL_CHANGES.md. Update both language
guides when public behavior changes. / 说明兼容影响，补充原生修改声明并同步中英文文档。
